name: kitchensink4web-dev
description: Field-test build of the KitchenSink4Web browser MCP server: same code as the shipped bundle, different install-screen defaults. Beta field-test build: every capability is switched on. The shipped product installs read-only.
long_description: This is the field-test build. It runs exactly the same server as the shipped bundle and differs only in what the install screen starts with: the cookies-and-logins pack is already on, because saving and reloading a login is what field tests spend their time on. Everything the shipped bundle refuses to do by default, this build still refuses: acting stays off until you turn it on, and the safety layer is the same one. Launching this bundle requires uv (the uvx command) on your machine; the server itself is fetched from PyPI on first launch. Use the shipped bundle for anything that is not a test.

allow_acting.title: Warning: DANGEROUS. Let Claude click and type on pages
allow_acting.description: Off: Claude can only read and navigate, and nothing on any page can be changed. On: Claude can click buttons and fill in forms. The risky submissions (payments, passwords, posts that reach people, deletions) still stop and ask you first, every time.

consent_scope.title: Submit routine forms without asking each time
consent_scope.description: Off: every form submission checks with you first. On: routine submissions like site searches go through on their own, while payments, passwords, posts, and deletions always ask.

pack_extract.title: Extract data from pages
pack_extract.description: Tables, lists, links, and article text, with CSV and JSON export.

pack_capture.title: Screenshots and page saving
pack_capture.description: Screenshots (passwords blurred), PDF export, and saving pages as files.

pack_storage.title: Cookies and logins
pack_storage.description: Use with care. Saves a signed-in session so Claude does not have to log in every time. It saves the session, never your password; treat the saved file like one anyway.

pack_files.title: Downloads and uploads
pack_files.description: Download files from pages into one folder, and upload files into page forms. Every one asks you first.

pack_network.title: Watch network traffic
pack_network.description: See the requests a page makes behind the scenes. Useful for debugging websites; most people leave it off.

pack_workflows.title: Recorded workflows
pack_workflows.description: Record a multi-step task once and replay it later. Every replay checks that the page still matches before anything runs.

pack_accessibility.title: Accessibility checks
pack_accessibility.description: Audit a page against accessibility rules. Needs an optional extra installed; the tool tells you how if it is missing.

pack_diagnostics.title: Warning: DANGEROUS. Run page scripts (advanced)
pack_diagnostics.description: Lets Claude run JavaScript on a page, one script at a time, each one shown to you for approval first. This is the most powerful and most dangerous setting on this page. Leave it off unless you know you need it.
